title: Dutch PHP Conference 2020
content:
Submit your talks no later than January 28th, 2020 We are looking for high-quality, technical sessions from speakers who can cover advanced topics and keep our demanding audience inspired. Submissions are accepted up to and including January 28th, 2020. This is your chance to share. Submit your talks now!

https://www.phpconference.nl
